body: > Again, connect* doesn't exist in v7, that's what could be made more clear in the migration script though. Thanks for your feedback! Sorry you may say this but it is there. So I would check the code and make sure... on checking react-instantsearch v7.2.0 you in-fact export everything from core, so one would expect not to have to install core at all and use `react-instantsearch` only. the below is a lot of connect functions considering they don't "exist" for v7 these functions are also **usable** but fail type checking. the below is your react-instantsearch-core types which indeed export connect* function type declarations So I appreciate your intention is that they don't exist... but they very much do and make your docs a TON more confusing... at the least this is a bug and not expected behaviour on either my part as the consumer reading your docs and your part as you say they shouldn't exist at all in v7 😅
